action_items: Optional: verify AI knowledge Save success toast text/duration — the PUT works but 'AI reply knowledge saved' string was not found in the DOM within 4s. If toast copy changed, update the E2E expectation; if toast is missing, add a user-visible success confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: Login redirect: admin.qa lands on /customer /dashboard after /login (since account also has customer profile) rather than /admin. Direct page.goto('/admin') can race the just-set httpOnly cookie and 401→/login on some browsers; using the 'Choose a panel' UI switcher works. Consider redirecting admins straight to /admin after login when is_admin=true, or making the /admin route wait for cookie hydration before firing auth check.
AI reply hard-rules are respected in the two drafts observed (no refund promise, no $ price). LLM latency: ~6s mail / ~2s WhatsApp — acceptable.

WA 'No customer message to reply to yet' alert works as documented; most of the 95 seeded conversations are outbound-only, so admins may hit the alert repeatedly. Consider surfacing a visual badge in the list showing which conversations have an inbound message so admins don't have to click through.
seed_data_creation: Edited AI reply knowledge via UI to: 'IslandHop TT — logistics + food delivery. Support hours 8am-8pm. Never promise refunds or quote prices.' with tone 'warm, friendly, Caribbean'. Per request this is fine to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the admin panel with admin.qa: after /login, click the 'Choose a panel' link in the top-left brand and pick 'Admin' from the menu — direct navigation to /admin can 401-race. Mail AI knowledge editor lives inside the auto-reply control bar (toggled by data-testid=ai-knowledge-toggle-btn). WhatsApp conversations use testid pattern 'wa-convo-<E164>'; most seeded threads are outbound-only so use 'wa-convo-+15166057352' which has inbound messages. NEVER click mail-send-reply-btn or wa-send-btn — those trigger real M365 / Twilio sends.
